## Download

**[Dom-V1-Installer.exe](https://github.com/adenthegoat565/Dom-V1/releases/latest/download/Dom-V1-Installer.exe)** (Windows 10/11)

1. Download and open `Dom-V1-Installer.exe`. If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click **More info → Run anyway** (the installer isn't code-signed).
2. Pick the extra mods you want and click **Install**.
3. Open the Minecraft Launcher, choose **Dom Client 26.2** next to the Play button, and press **Play**.

In game: **Right Shift** opens the click GUI, **C** zooms, **V** sets up voice chat.

Includes Fabric Loader, Fabric API, Simple Voice Chat and the Dom Client click GUI. Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, Entity Culling, Mod Menu and Iris are optional. Mods are downloaded from Modrinth during install and checked against their SHA-512 hashes.
